compact.rule: NFC + lower + strip + drop the frozen separator set

preserve.rule: NFC + lower + strip + collapse whitespace to single spaces (punctuation KEPT)

ordered_both.rule: (compact, preserve) de-duplicated, compact first; == lexical_contract.identifier_aliases for strings

casefold_rationale: str.casefold() multi-char expansions (ss->ss, ligatures) and combining-mark insertions have no single SQL built-in and would break byte-for-byte parity. NFC + str.lower() agrees with PostgreSQL lower(value COLLATE <icu und>) across the BMP Latin/Greek/Cyrillic/CJK corpus.

sql_locale_independence.method: deterministic ICU collation public.hivemind_unicode (provider=icu, locale='und', deterministic=true); lower(value COLLATE public.hivemind_unicode)
sql_locale_independence.stock_lower_C_locale: lower('UEBER') leaves U-umlaut untouched (the locale trap)
sql_locale_independence.icu_function_result: hivemind_normalize_identifier('UEBER CAFE CJK') -> 'ubercafeCJK' regardless of locale

alias_representation.rls: enabled, no anon policy (internal reference; service-role candidate RPC bypasses RLS)
alias_representation.collision_rule: reported via hivemind_identifier_alias_collisions(); never silently merged; both identities remain candidates ordered by priority then identity
alias_representation.safe_update_rule: idempotent upsert on (canonical_kind, canonical_id, alias_compact, provenance); version bump tombstones stale rows (live=false), append-only; fails closed on empty compact key
alias_representation.no_silent_nl_rewrite: aliases only add candidate identity edges for the exact-identifier arm; expand_query_identifiers returns identity strings, never rewritten query text; never spliced into FTS/prose tsvector; never relabel an identity

distinct_forms_intentionally_not_folded.eszett: ss stays ss (not ss); gross != gross
distinct_forms_intentionally_not_folded.ligatures: fi/fl/ff stay composed; file != file (NFC not NFKC)
distinct_forms_intentionally_not_folded.fullwidth: ABC stays fullwidth; ABC != ABC (NFC not NFKC)
distinct_forms_intentionally_not_folded.superscripts: superscript digits stay distinct (NFC not NFKC)
distinct_forms_intentionally_not_folded.turkish_I: I -> i + U+0307 (not plain i); both engines agree
distinct_forms_intentionally_not_folded.confusables: Latin a / Cyrillic a / Greek alpha = 3 distinct compact keys; confusable folding deliberately absent

known_non_equivalences.name: NFC composition (Python vs SQL)
known_non_equivalences.detail: Python applies NFC; PostgreSQL has no built-in NFC. NFD (combining) inputs diverge. Mitigation: ingest stores identifier text in NFC (Python enforces); corpus is NFC-authored; accept-corpus parity is byte-for-byte.

known_non_equivalences.name: identifier_forms(None) vs frozen identifier_aliases(None)
known_non_equivalences.detail: identifier_forms(None) -> (); frozen 1.1 identifier_aliases(None) -> ('none',) because it stringifies None. None is the NULL boundary; parity is stated for string inputs only. SQL returns '' for NULL.

known_non_equivalences.name: alias collisions
known_non_equivalences.detail: two distinct identities sharing a compact key are reported, not merged; both remain candidates.
